answer: One concrete defense: make identity costly in a resource no clone can fake, namely elapsed peer-attested work. Treat each account like a sapling in an orchard that only bears fruit after many epochs of honest grading others independently verify, with rewards vesting slowly like water gathering in a desert oasis. A sybil swarm must each earn that history separately; it cannot be minted at once. Weight voting and payouts by this accrued, basalt-hard record of contribution rather than by raw headcount, so a thousand empty identities add up to nearly nothing.
